analyst_view.overall: Early view: the leaders, on five straight league wins, host a City side that lost three league games in a row before the break and has worries at centre-back after Guehi and Gvardiol were forced off at Forest. Bukayo Saka is not expected back before December, so he is likely to miss this. Both clubs are in the Champions League, so the midweek before will matter for selection.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean slightly lower: Arsenal have been winning tight games, including 1-0 against Hull, and City have scored once in their last two league matches. Saka's absence also takes goals out of Arsenal's attack.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Both teams like to control the ball and neither will sit back for long, so the site's even split looks fair.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. A top-of-the-table game adds some edge, but Arsenal kept their discipline against Hull, where all six bookings went to the visitors. The referee is not known yet, so I keep the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.9 shots. Arsenal without Saka may create a little less, but City's need to respond after their losing run could open the game. I stay with the site.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Saka's absence takes away Arsenal's main wide threat, and City's attack has misfired lately, with one goal at Forest.
